talking-with-launa-to-start.player: What's this big hole in the ground all about?

talking-with-launa-to-start.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start.text: Oh I wish I knew for sure... All I do know is that it opened seemingly by itself a few months ago. It was first discovered by the students over at the digsite, a few of which have gone down there but never returned.

talking-with-launa-to-start.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start.text: They told me about it straight away.

talking-with-launa-to-start.player: So why is it important to you?

talking-with-launa-to-start.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start.text: A few reasons, but I think the situation is beyond help now.

talking-with-launa-to-start.player: What situation? Maybe I can help.

talking-with-launa-to-start.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start.text: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to tell you. I'm waiting to see my son Tolna. Don't suppose you've seen him?

talking-with-launa-to-start.player: Your son, Tolna? I don't know, what does he look like?
You don't know what your own son looks like?

talking-with-launa-to-start.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start.text: No. You see, I haven't seen him for... for... 25 years now. He just ran away one day and never returned. I'm hoping he's down this rift as I know he headed in this direction. My husband went to look, but he hasn't

talking-with-launa-to-start.prompt: Start the A Soul's Bane quest?

steps.player: Would you like me to go down to look for your husband and son?

steps.speaker: Launa
steps.text: You would do that? Oh thank you so much!

steps.speaker: Launa
steps.text: Thank you. You can use a rope to get into the rift, just attach it at the edge.

steps.player: Surely by now they'd both be dead?

steps.speaker: Launa
steps.text: How could you say such a thing? Get away from me!

talking-with-launa-to-start-talking-with.player: Sorry, what am I supposed to do again?

talking-with-launa-to-start-talking-with.speaker: Launa
talking-with-launa-to-start-talking-with.text: Go into the rift beside me and find my husband and son!

room-of-rage.text: The player enters the rift with the rope.
The camera pans around the room and ends on the tunnel into the room of fear

room-of-rage.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-rage.text: Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place?

room-of-rage.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-rage.text: Arrghh, It's not fair! Feel my ANGER!

room-of-rage-weapon-rack.prompt: Which weapon would you like to take?

options.text: Yes, I don't mind starting this room again.

steps.text: The player leaves to the entrance of the rift.

options.text: No, I'll finish this room first.

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.player: Hi, I've been down into the rift and I found a strange room. I also heard a voice claiming to be called Tolna.

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.speaker: Launa
room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.text: My son! What did he say?

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.player: He said, 'Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place? Feel my ANGER!'.

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.speaker: Launa
room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.text: Who can be surprised at his frustration?

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.player: It's a very aggressive room. I think I need to defeat the monsters in there.

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.speaker: Launa
room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-ente.text: Don't waste any time, his life could depend on you.

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: The player disperses demon-looking anger monsters from the room

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.player: Wow! How did I do that? There's something truly mental about this place!

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: Fade to black, a cutscene in Varrock to see young Launa and Tolna

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.speaker: Tolna
room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: I can't live with your rules any more, Mother.

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.speaker: Tolna
room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: I'm tired of working hard for very little money. There's great wealth that's mine for the taking!

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.speaker: Launa
room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: But why? We're surviving perfectly fine on what we're earning.

room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.speaker: Tolna
room-of-rage-after-filling-the-rage-leve.text: I'm tired of your pathetic outlook. Good bye.

room-of-rage-talking-to-launa-after-watc.player: I managed to defeat the monsters in the room!
Sorry, I've yet to enter the next room.

room-of-fear.text: The camera pans around the room looking at the dark holes

room-of-fear.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-fear.text: It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place.

room-of-fear.player: Hmmm, no light sources. So why can I still see down here? This can't just be a simple dungeon.

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.player: Hi. I've made my way into a second room. I heard your son's voice again as well.

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.speaker: Launa
room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.text: What did he say? What did he say?

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.player: 'It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place. Mum, help me!'

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.speaker: Launa
room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-ente.text: You must save him! Help him get over his fear!

room-of-fear-re-entering-the-room-of-fea.player: Hmmm, no light sources. So why can I still see down here? This can't just be a simple dungeon.

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-first-rea.player: I don't like looking in these holes but I must!

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-second-re.player: I don't feel quite so afraid now.

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-forth-rea.player: This isn't so scary after all!

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-last-reap.text: The player kills the last scary face.

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-last-reap.player: Phew, I don't feel so scared now. This feels like the figment of someone's imagination!

room-of-fear-after-killing-the-last-reap.text: fade to black, to the location of the rift before it fully opened to see Tolna fall in

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-comp.player: I've overcome fear in the second room and an exit has been illuminated.
Erm, I haven't actually ventured through yet.

room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-comp.speaker: Launa
room-of-fear-talking-to-launa-after-comp.text: What are you waiting for? He must be so afraid in that place.

room-of-confusion.text: The camera pans around the room looking at the confusing doors

room-of-confusion.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-confusion.text: Where am I? How long have I been here? Am I still the person I once was?

room-of-confusion.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-confusion.text: Oh why am I so CONFUSED?

room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.player: Hi, I've journeyed through to a third room. Your son's voice spoke as I entered.
Simply, 'Where am I? How long have I been here? Am I still the person I once was? I hate my CONFUSION'.

room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.speaker: Launa
room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.text: You have to help him overcome his confusion!

room-of-confusion-killing-the-last-confu.text: Those other monsters were just hallucinations!

room-of-confusion-after-revealing-the-fi.player: Aha! The exit is now clear! This Tolna's mind really is a mess.

room-of-confusion-after-revealing-the-fi.text: Cutscene starts to see Tolna sitting in the confusion room

room-of-confusion-after-revealing-the-fi.speaker: Tolna
room-of-confusion-after-revealing-the-fi.text: Leave me... But I don't want to... How can you say that...

room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.player: Hi. I have prevailed over a third room.

room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.speaker: Launa
room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.text: Are you any closer to finding my son?

room-of-confusion-talking-to-launa-after.player: I think I may be getting closer.

room-of-hopelessness.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-hopelessness.text: What's the point? No-one will ever help me.

room-of-hopelessness.speaker: Tolna's Voice
room-of-hopelessness.text: I'm not worth anything. Will anyone ever combat my HOPELESSNESS?

room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.player: I have travelled through to a fourth room. As I entered your son's voice spoke to me!

room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.speaker: Launa
room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.text: Oh my! What did he say?

room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.player: He said, 'What's the point? Why do I defy such HOPELESSNESS? No-one will ever help me'.

room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.speaker: Launa
room-of-hopelessness-talking-to-launa-af.text: You must fight to give him back his hope!

room-of-hopelessness-after-killing-the-f.player: Is there any end to killing these monsters?

room-of-hopelessness-after-killing-the-t.player: I've almost killed them all now!

room-of-hopelessness-after-killing-the-f.player: Maybe if I kill one more?

room-of-hopelessness-after-killing-the-l.text: A flash of bright light and a bridge of hope appears.

room-of-hopelessness-after-killing-the-l.player: A bridge of hope! Tolna should feel that help is at hand by now!

room-of-hopelessness-launa-after-the-hop.player: I have endured against hopelessness to finish the fourth room.

Only his voice. So far he has said to me, 'Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place? Feel my ANGER!', 'It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place. Mum, help me!', 'Where
am I? How long have I been here? Am I still the person I once was? I hate my CONFUSION' and 'What's the point? Why do I defy such HOPELESSNESS? No-one will ever help me'.

room-of-hopelessness-launa-after-the-hop.speaker: Launa
room-of-hopelessness-launa-after-the-hop.text: You must find him and bring him back to me. Please, I beg you.

room-of-hopelessness-launa-after-the-hop.player: Don't worry, I will find him!

finding-tolna.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna.text: Sorry, but your mother and I...

finding-tolna.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna.text: tried so hard to find you!

finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.text: Please! You must help my son! He's beyond sense.

finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.text: I take it you have travelled through the mental dilemmas of my son, as I have.

finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-brana.text: Now you must do what I cannot, conquer the physical dilemma!

finding-tolna-talking-to-launa.player: And your husband, but I'm afraid your son is no longer physically what he once was.

finding-tolna-after-defeating-tolna-s-bo.text: Tolna's human body appears on the narrow path

finding-tolna-talking-to-brana-after-def.player: I think I've saved your son.

finding-tolna-talking-to-brana-after-def.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-brana-after-def.text: Please talk to him, make sure he's OK!

finding-tolna-talking-to-launa-after-def.player: I have returned your son to his normal state!
Er, no, sorry. I just came back here to tell you.

finding-tolna-talking-to-launa-after-def.speaker: Launa
finding-tolna-talking-to-launa-after-def.text: What are you waiting for, bring him back to me!

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.player: You've been trapped down here for years. I've come to rescue you on behalf of your parents.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Tolna
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: Oh yeah. I was looking for the legacy of a civilisation that used to live down here.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Tolna
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: Father? Oh, I'm so sorry, can you ever forgive me?

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: Don't worry, I'm just glad you're back to yourself. Are you OK?

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Tolna
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: I'm fine, my memories are slowly returning. How's mother?

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.player: She's up at the surface waiting for you.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Brana
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: Thank you traveller, I'm glad my wife and I never gave up hope. We should return to her and tell her the good news.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.speaker: Tolna
finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: Thank you so much. I truly owe you for your help.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.player: I'm just glad I could help.

finding-tolna-talking-to-human-tolna.text: The player is transported to above surface.

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: Hi. Thanks again for saving me, I'm so glad to be out of that horrible place. I was foolish to ignore my parents' warnings when I ran away that day. Luckily I've been able to patch things up with them so they've

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: returned home with peace of mind.

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.player: What exactly happened to you down there?

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: I managed to find the remnants of the ancient civilisation that the stories talked about. It seems people used to worship a god there years ago in numbers far greater than a simple cult following. Sadly there is little

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: remaining so I have nothing else to tell. As soon as I entered this area the ground swallowed me whole. I felt there was something watching, waiting. It's like there is some evil power under the ground that wanted me to

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: suffer. As if it got some sort of empowerment from it. At least what ever it is, it doesn't want to reveal itself to the world yet...

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.player: At least we have a warning. Did you manage to retrieve anything?

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: Not really, just a few coins, which you're welcome to have.

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.player: Thanks. So what are you going to do now?

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: I've decided to keep open the rift. There is a part of it that is perfectly laid out for combat training and remnants of my subconscious remain in there. I want to show people the problems I have faced, so that they

talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.speaker: Tolna
talking-to-tolna-on-the-surface.text: may learn from them. You're welcome to go down there and practice fighting any time.
